starter_questions: What do you need from me to create a useful summary?
How can I try the bundled sample files?

setup_guide.introduction: I'll turn the files you choose into a summary, or another deliverable you describe. Try the synthetic sample, or choose your own read-only input folder, separate output folder and instructions. Review the selected folders before starting; Downloads contains your files.

sample.title: File summary sample
sample.description: Summarize synthetic Java and Markdown files without supplying your own documents. Normal model preparation still applies.
sample.expected_output: With the default summary instructions, a saved answer and deliverables/summary.md, with actual checks and anything unfinished.

real.introduction: Choose the read-only input folder, a separate output folder and instructions describing the result you want. I’ll deliver new work in output and explain the checks and anything unfinished.

fields.label: Input folder
fields.description: Read-only task material, including Markdown files and source code. Generated work belongs only in the output folder.
